text:
Zoe: Heads-up — Nimbus (beta) asked if we can include per-tenant quota controls + regional inference in the MVP. We need a quick decision: ship lighter MVP now or push those to v1?

Marco: Infra POV: per-tenant quotas are medium effort (rate-limiter + billing hook). Regional inference is heavy: cross-region KV cache + routing. Recommend quotas in MVP (soft limits) and region failover deferred to v1.

Priya: Product proposal: MVP = core API + soft tenant quotas + model variant pin (single quantized model), observability basics. v1 = region routing, quota admin UI, advanced billing. Rationale: quotas unblock Nimbus pilot; regional routing is infra-heavy.

Ben: SRE: If we keep quotas in MVP we must add p99 latency SLOs and a documented burst-cap policy. Also need a fast rollback path for the quota enforcer in case of regressions.

Kelsey: UX: admin UI for quotas is expensive. For MVP we can expose a simple flaggable CSV upload and an API endpoint for quota adjustments, ship full UI in v1. Saves 2 design sprints.

Marco: Technical note: model variant pinning + quantized runtime requires a canary to ensure no p99 regression. Suggest canary rollout on model pin with traffic ramp 2%->20%->100% and automated signal checks for p99 and 5xx.

infra-bot: rollout/created: 1713004321-model-pin-canary (owner: Marco) — checks: p99, 5xx, mem-usage, kv-latency.

Zoe: Sales input from Nimbus: they accept soft quotas and API-based admin for MVP if we commit to region plan by v1 timeline (v1 = MVP + 8w). Need that on the external roadmap.

Priya: Action items: (1) Marco/Bob (infra) to draft the canary playbook and rollback hooks by EOD tomorrow; (2) Kelsey to ship CSV admin flow + minimal API contract mock by end of sprint; (3) Ben to define SLOs & automated alert thresholds; (4) Priya to update roadmap with external comms (Nimbus) and mark feature gating. If all agree we keep regional inference in v1 and quotas in MVP.

Marco: I'll post a short infra checklist in-thread when scheduled.

Kelsey: Will produce a quick spec for the CSV admin flow — no UI screens for MVP.

Priya: OK thanks — if nothing else Ill freeze the MVP cutlist tonight and create the release ticket. :white_check_mark:
